summary_en: Introduces ST-CWI-Net for recovering full-aperture phase-sensitive FMC radio-frequency data from sparse breast-USCT acquisitions. The model combines adjacent temporal RF slices, wavelet-domain fusion, sampling-mask conditioning, spectral gating, and hard data consistency, enabling faster transmit acquisition or reduced receive-channel hardware while retaining high downstream MVDR reconstruction fidelity.
